program_narrative: Program TSTVAL00 is a batch test-validation driver that ends with GOBACK. It opens the input files TEST-CASES, EXPECTED-RESULTS and ACTUAL-RESULTS and the output report TEST-REPORT, writes two report header lines, clears its test metrics and records the start time. The main loop reads TEST-CASES until end of file and, for each test case, selects a test runner by TEST-TYPE ('FUNCTIONAL', 'INTEGRATE', 'PERFORM' or 'ERROR') and then validates the results, updates the metrics and writes a detail line; all of these paragraphs (2200-2800) are not present in the program, so the actual test execution and comparison logic cannot be traced. After the loop it records the end time, computes the elapsed time and the success rate (passed / total * 100, with no zero-division guard) and writes a summary line. Error conditions handled: a failed OPEN of any of the four files and an unrecognised test type; the error handler displays WS-ERROR-MESSAGE (not declared in the program or its copybooks), sets return code 12 and ends the program immediately.
